items.title: Oil prices dip amid Iran peace hopes, improving supplies
items.summary: Investing.com-- Oil prices fell in early Asian trade on Tuesday after U.S. President Donald Trump said the Iran war was going to end soon, while other data pointed to improving supplies despite disruptions in the Middle East.

items.title: Occidental beats Q3 forecasts as production offsets lower crude prices
items.summary: Investing.com -- Occidental Petroleum Corporation (NYSE:OXY) delivered a decisive third-quarter earnings beat on Monday, lifted by operational outperformance in its core shale basins and substantial debt-reduction progress. The Houston-based producer posted adjusted earnings of $1.91 per share, topping analyst expectations of $1.34 by $0.57, while revenue reached $6.77 billion against a projected $6.61 billion.

items.title: U.S. consumer prices seen rising 3.8% year-on-year in October - Truflation
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. consumer prices are estimated to have risen by 3.8% in the twelve months to October and 0.3% month-on-month, amid ongoing upward pressure from elevated energy costs caused by the Iran war, according to Truflation predictions.

items.title: ECB’s Lagarde says inflation to stay high, sees little reason to alter rate course
items.summary: Investing.com - Euro zone inflation will remain elevated over the coming quarters, European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde said, signaling that it would take "significant changes" to deter policymakers from raising interest rates again in December.
